title: Cross-phase prep: split hub files once (pure moves, no behaviour change)
player_outcome: Nothing visible. Every later WP can grow hub files without breaching the 400-line CI limit and without redoing the same split.
design: Move class PlayerEntity (currently inside src/Strata.Core/Session/GameWorld.cs) verbatim into src/Strata.Core/Session/PlayerEntity.cs (same namespace/usings).

Split src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Interaction/ItemUseSystem.cs: move Shoot() and FindAmmo() (and private helpers only they use) into partial ItemUseSystem.Shooting.cs; move Consume(), the Refused event, Summon(), StartEvent() and ConsumeHeld() into partial ItemUseSystem.Consume.cs (exact name Consume.cs).
Split src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Entities/NpcSystem.cs: move Kill, DeathEffects and GroupAlive (and helpers only they use) into partial NpcSystem.Death.cs.
Move BossInfo, BossPart, BossRitual, DayEnrage and KillShield (and any other boss-only types) out of src/Strata.Core/Content/Defs/EnemyDef.cs into src/Strata.Core/Content/Defs/BossInfo.cs.

Split src/Strata.Core/Content/Validation/ContentValidator.World.cs: move ValidateEnemies and ValidatePattern into ContentValidator.Enemies.cs; ValidateProjectilesAndBuffs and ValidateLoot into ContentValidator.Projectiles.cs (partials). Keep biomes/events/flags/obtainability in World.cs.

Split game/Bootstrap/WorldLauncher.cs into partial files WorldLauncher.Player.cs, WorldLauncher.Effects.cs, WorldLauncher.Ui.cs and WorldLauncher.Assets.cs grouping the existing wiring by concern (the class must be partial; keep _Ready order identical by calling private helper methods defined in the partials).
Add game/Player/PlayerController.Fall.cs (move TrackFall and fall-damage code) and game/Player/InteractionController.Talk.cs (move UpdateTalkTarget and DigDownTarget).

Split GameWorld save/player-file code: move SaveAll/SavePlayer (instance) into src/Strata.Core/Session/GameWorld.Saving.cs and static WritePlayer/LoadOrCreatePlayer/DeletePlayer/PlayerPath into GameWorld.PlayerFiles.cs (partials). If they do not exist with those names, move the equivalent save/player-file members.
Code moves only: identical behaviour, identical public API, no renames except making classes partial. Keep usings minimal and compile warnings at 0.
tests: No new tests. Entire Core suite must pass unchanged (golden hashes byte-identical).
verification: check_file_length: all touched files < 300 lines where possible
dotnet build Strata.sln + Strata.csproj with 0 warnings added
smoke basic, combat, bosses, town print SMOKE PASS
git diff --stat shows moves (similar added/removed counts)
risks: Everything later depends on this; keep it a pure move so review is trivial.
